message.CONTENT_EN: Due to traffic accident , part of the lanes of Tuen Mun Road (Tuen Mun bound) near Hong Kong Garden is closed to all traffic. Only remaining lane is available to motorists. Traffic is busy now.

message.CONTENT_EN: Due to traffic accident , part of the lanes of Tuen Mun Road (Tuen Mun bound) near Hong Kong Garden is still being closed to all traffic. Only remaining lane is available to motorists. Traffic queue on Tuen Mun Road (Tuen Mun bound) ends at Tuen Mun Road near Tsing Long Highway (Ting Kau Bridge). Traffic is congested now.
